overview: This paper proposes N-HMC and NA-NHMC, posterior sampling methods in the initial noise space of diffusion models using Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, to solve inverse problems without task-specific tuning and adapt to unknown noise levels.

modules.name: DDIM Deterministic Decoder Module
modules.description: Implements the deterministic Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) mapping to treat the reverse diffusion process as a deterministic function mapping initial noise to clean images, supporting gradient backpropagation through a few denoising steps.

modules.name: Forward Operator & Measurement Synthesis Module
modules.description: Defines forward operators for various linear and nonlinear inverse problems (Super Resolution, Inpainting, Deblurring, Phase Retrieval, HDR) and synthesizes noisy measurements with Gaussian, Impulse, and Speckle noise.

modules.name: N-HMC Hamiltonian & Gradient Calculator
modules.description: Calculates the potential energy, kinetic energy, and their gradients for the Noise-space HMC with known Gaussian measurement noise, incorporating the prior term and the likelihood term.

modules.name: NA-NHMC Hamiltonian & Gradient Calculator
modules.description: Calculates the potential energy, kinetic energy, and their gradients for the Noise-Adaptive N-HMC by marginalizing the noise variance with a Jeffreys prior, yielding a parameter-free likelihood term.

modules.name: Leapfrog Integrator & MH Acceptor
modules.description: Implements the leapfrog integration steps for simulating Hamiltonian dynamics to propose new states, and the Metropolis-Hastings acceptance criterion to correct discretization errors, including adaptive step size annealing on rejection.

modules.name: HMC Sampling Orchestrator
modules.description: Manages the overall HMC sampling loop, initializing momentum, executing leapfrog steps, handling acceptance, and implementing the noise level annealing schedule for N-HMC or the transition to noise-adaptive updates for NA-NHMC.

modules.name: Image Quality Metrics Module
modules.description: Computes reconstruction quality metrics including Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM), and Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (LPIPS).

modules.name: Baseline Methods Integration Module
modules.description: Configures and executes comparative baseline methods using their specified hyperparameter settings and stopping criteria for fair comparison across different inverse problem tasks.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Analysis Runner
modules.description: Executes controlled experiments to evaluate the impact of hyperparameters (step size, leapfrog steps, decay factor), the number of HMC iterations, and the number of diffusion steps on reconstruction performance.

modules.name: Noise Robustness Validation Module
modules.description: Evaluates the method's robustness and adaptability to unknown measurement noise types and levels by testing the noise-adaptive variant with identical hyperparameters across diverse noise distributions and intensities.

modules.name: Visualization & Report Generation Module
modules.description: Generates qualitative visual comparisons of reconstructions, uncertainty standard deviation heatmaps, convergence plots, and automated LaTeX tables for the quantitative evaluation metrics.
